summary: Resource access lists move from /api/v2/{model}/{id}/access_list/ to /api/gateway/v1/role_user_access/{model_api_slug}/{id}/; hub keycloak login and /api/v3/auth/token move to gateway social and tokens endpoints; EDA uses gateway organizations, teams, users and role endpoints.
questions: What replaced access_list in the AAP 2.6 API?
Where did automation hub token authentication move in 2.6?
How do I list users with access to a credential in 2.6?
Do EDA API integrations need changes for 2.6?
